title: OpenPAC Claim Mode Switch
description: Claim gamemode menu for Open Parties and Claims with trusts, homes, bypasses and Creative Inventory hybrid modes.
body:
Claim Mode Switch is a NeoForge mod for servers using Open Parties and Claims.

It adds a claim-aware gamemode system with a clean in-game menu. Players can manage trusted players, homes and personal claim modes through `/cc` or a configurable keybind. Server admins can configure how gamemodes behave on own claims, trusted claims, foreign claims and wilderness areas.

Features:

* In-game menu opened with `/cc`
* Configurable keybind, default: `H`
* Open Parties and Claims integration
* Trust system using player heads in the menu
* Admin menu for claim gamemode rules
* Bypass and Builderpass management through menus
* Small on-screen status display for Bypass and Builderpass
* Home system with configurable home limit
* Homes can only be set on your own claims or claims where you are trusted
* Home teleport countdown with ESC cancellation
* Creative Inventory hybrid mode
* Hybrid mode gives access to the Creative inventory without flight or invulnerability
* Survival-style HUD in hybrid mode with hearts, hunger, XP bar and absorption hearts
* Players can switch personal modes on their own claims if enabled by admins
* Persistent storage for trusts, homes, bypass players, builderpass players and settings

Usage:

* `/cc` opens the main menu
* `H` opens the main menu by default
* The keybind can be changed in Minecraft’s controls menu

Dependencies:

* Open Parties and Claims is required
* NeoForge is required

Recommended:

* Xaero’s World Map and Xaero’s Minimap can be used together with Open Parties and Claims, but they are not required directly by this mod.

Important:
This mod must be installed on both the server and the client, because it includes client-side features such as keybinds, HUD overlays and custom menu rendering.
